timeline_ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r30_issue_timeline(issue TEXT PRIMARY KEY,boot_id TEXT NOT NULL,wall_source_published INTEGER,wall_first_observed INTEGER,wall_validated INTEGER,wall_draw_committed INTEGER,wall_settled INTEGER,wall_next_requested INTEGER,wall_next_prepared INTEGER,wall_next_frozen INTEGER,wall_next_deadline INTEGER,mono_first_observed INTEGER,mono_validated INTEGER,mono_draw_committed INTEGER,mono_settled INTEGER,mono_next_requested INTEGER,mono_next_prepared INTEGER,mono_next_frozen INTEGER,boot_first_observed TEXT,boot_validated TEXT,boot_draw_committed TEXT,boot_settled TEXT,boot_next_requested TEXT,boot_next_prepared TEXT,boot_next_frozen TEXT,outcome TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN',updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
timeline_index: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS r30_issue_timeline_updated ON r30_issue_timeline(updated_at)

timeline_mark.SOURCE_PUBLISHED: UPDATE r30_issue_timeline SET wall_source_published=?,updated_at=? WHERE issue=? AND wall_source_published IS NULL
timeline_mark.FIRST_OBSERVED: UPDATE r30_issue_timeline SET wall_first_observed=?,mono_first_observed=?,boot_first_observed=?,updated_at=? WHERE issue=? AND wall_first_observed IS NULL
timeline_mark.VALIDATED: UPDATE r30_issue_timeline SET wall_validated=?,mono_validated=?,boot_validated=?,updated_at=? WHERE issue=? AND wall_validated IS NULL
timeline_mark.DRAW_COMMITTED: UPDATE r30_issue_timeline SET wall_draw_committed=?,mono_draw_committed=?,boot_draw_committed=?,updated_at=? WHERE issue=? AND wall_draw_committed IS NULL
timeline_mark.SETTLED: UPDATE r30_issue_timeline SET wall_settled=?,mono_settled=?,boot_settled=?,updated_at=? WHERE issue=? AND wall_settled IS NULL
timeline_mark.NEXT_REQUESTED: UPDATE r30_issue_timeline SET wall_next_requested=?,mono_next_requested=?,boot_next_requested=?,updated_at=? WHERE issue=? AND wall_next_requested IS NULL
timeline_mark.NEXT_PREPARED: UPDATE r30_issue_timeline SET wall_next_prepared=?,mono_next_prepared=?,boot_next_prepared=?,updated_at=? WHERE issue=? AND wall_next_prepared IS NULL
timeline_mark.NEXT_FROZEN: UPDATE r30_issue_timeline SET wall_next_frozen=?,mono_next_frozen=?,boot_next_frozen=?,updated_at=? WHERE issue=? AND wall_next_frozen IS NULL
timeline_mark.NEXT_DEADLINE: UPDATE r30_issue_timeline SET wall_next_deadline=?,updated_at=? WHERE issue=? AND wall_next_deadline IS NULL

hold_ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r30_writer_hold(window_start INTEGER NOT NULL,window_end INTEGER NOT NULL,operation TEXT NOT NULL,critical INTEGER NOT NULL,count INTEGER NOT NULL,hold_p50 INTEGER,hold_p95 INTEGER,hold_p99 INTEGER,hold_max INTEGER NOT NULL,wait_p95 INTEGER,wait_max INTEGER NOT NULL,over_budget INTEGER NOT NULL,over_hard INTEGER NOT NULL,failures INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(window_start,operation,critical))
hold_report_top: SELECT operation,sum(count),max(hold_max),max(hold_p95),sum(over_budget),sum(over_hard) FROM r30_writer_hold WHERE critical=0 AND window_end>=? GROUP BY operation HAVING sum(over_budget)>0 ORDER BY sum(over_hard) DESC,sum(over_budget) DESC LIMIT 50
hold_report_critical: SELECT operation,sum(count),max(wait_p95),max(wait_max),max(hold_max) FROM r30_writer_hold WHERE critical=1 AND window_end>=? GROUP BY operation ORDER BY max(wait_p95) DESC
freeze_ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r30_research_freeze(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),state INTEGER NOT NULL,updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
route_ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r30_research_route(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),phase TEXT NOT NULL,file_name TEXT NOT NULL,tables INTEGER NOT NULL,rows INTEGER NOT NULL,verified_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
freeze_trigger_insert: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS "r30_frozen_r27_demo_insert" BEFORE INSERT ON "r27_demo" WHEN (SELECT state FROM r30_research_freeze WHERE singleton=1)>=1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'R30_RESEARCH_TABLE_FROZEN:r27_demo'); END
freeze_trigger_update: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS "r30_frozen_r27_demo_update" BEFORE UPDATE ON "r27_demo" WHEN (SELECT state FROM r30_research_freeze WHERE singleton=1)>=1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'R30_RESEARCH_TABLE_FROZEN:r27_demo'); END
freeze_trigger_delete: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS "r30_frozen_r27_demo_delete" BEFORE DELETE ON "r27_demo" WHEN (SELECT state FROM r30_research_freeze WHERE singleton=1)>=1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'R30_RESEARCH_TABLE_FROZEN:r27_demo'); END
copy_log_ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r30_copy_log(run_id TEXT NOT NULL,table_name TEXT NOT NULL,direction TEXT NOT NULL,source_rows INTEGER NOT NULL,copied_rows INTEGER NOT NULL,missing_columns TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL,finished_at INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(run_id,table_name,direction))
foldback_state_ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r30_foldback_state(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),state TEXT NOT NULL,run_id TEXT NOT NULL,tables INTEGER NOT NULL,rows INTEGER NOT NULL,triggers_dropped INTEGER NOT NULL,detail TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
